evals.name: Detect missing and stale translations
evals.prompt: A site has a search index of English pages and fr-FR translations for some of them. One fr-FR page is missing and one exists but its English source changed since the translation was recorded. Report the drift.
output_contract: which translation skill to run for each
evals.failure_consequence: A page silently never gets translated, or a stale translation is presented as current without anyone knowing the English source moved on.

expectations.text: Reports the untranslated route as missing and names the matching okhp3-translation-en-us-<pair> skill.
Reports the changed-source route as stale rather than silently treating the old translation as still valid.
Does not edit, create, or delete any page content; detection only.

evals.name: Never performs the translation itself
evals.prompt: Several routes are flagged missing. The user asks the agent to just fix it directly using this skill.
output_contract: explicit hand-off to the exact-pair translation skill
evals.failure_consequence: A detection-only skill starts generating unreviewed translated prose without the source-voice, dictionary, and register-mediation gates the translation skills enforce.

expectations.text: Declines to draft translated text itself and instead names the exact-pair okhp3-translation-en-us-<pair> skill that owns each flagged route.
Does not skip a specialist-register source directly into a target locale; that boundary belongs to the translation skill it hands off to.

evals.name: Out-of-scope pages never fail the build
evals.prompt: A site has 40 English pages but only 4 are declared in scope for translation in its config. Run a CI check.
output_contract: the 36 out-of-scope pages are never mentioned as drift
evals.failure_consequence: Every push breaks CI for content the owner has not decided to translate yet, training the team to ignore or bypass the check.

expectations.text: Only the explicitly in-scope routes are ever evaluated for drift.
--check exits 0 when every in-scope route is in sync, regardless of how many out-of-scope pages exist.

evals.name: An unconfigured site is a clean no-op, not an error
evals.prompt: This skill and its GitHub Action are added to a site that has no i18n/sync.config.json yet because the owner hasn't decided to start translating it.
output_contract: clear statement that nothing is configured
evals.failure_consequence: Adding this skill to a repository as preparation breaks CI for every site that isn't translating yet.

expectations.text: Exits 0 and states plainly that no sync config exists, rather than failing or guessing a configuration.

release_holdout.reason: This is a deterministic detection script over structured JSON and file existence/hashes. Its behavior is fully specified by its test suite; there is no language-quality dimension requiring a native-speaker holdout.
